lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of 4 to 6 high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a repetitive spatial grid across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal alignment of the high-luminance blobs to form a structured, lattice-like anchor node pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the superior edge and a shadow-defined inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin contains a high-density distribution of smaller, irregularly spaced high-luminance points distinct from the structured grid on the main flank.
